messages:
maya (product): Quick sync — need final UX decisions for the API Keys surface: create modal behavior, secret reveal, revoke flow wording, and empty-state options before we freeze the UI for the release.

leo (design): Two high-level things: (1) make the modal primary CTA 'Create key' (not 'Done'), (2) the secret reveal needs to feel protected 1) prominent notice + copy, 2) quick actions (copy/download) visible, 3) clear follow-up steps.

toni (devex): Implementation preference: inline reveal with short TTL and masking afterwards. Drawer is safer visually but adds complexity. For download we should provide a generated .env blob, not a raw link.

ravi (eng): Technical constraints: we can mask the secret in DOM after 20s and clear from memory. Must ensure analytics never capture the secret and events use hashed identifiers. Drawer would be extra component work, timeline not great.

elsa (a11y): If inline, announce via aria-live: 'New API key created, secret available for copy'. Copy button must have aria-label that mentions it won't be shown again. Focus management: after create, focus should move to the secret region.

leo (design): Suggested banner copy: "Save this secret now 1 it won't be shown again." Microcopy: "You can rotate later. See docs." Short, clear. For the notice color, ensure contrast meets AA.

maya (product): Good. Also want a secondary 'Download .env' CTA. Make Copy primary, Download secondary, and include a small checkbox 'Include sample usage' in the modal that toggles extra lines.

toni (devex): We'll use JS Blob for download (no raw href). Prefill sample: REDWOOD_API_KEY, REGION, EXAMPLE_BASE_URL. Add toggle state in UI.

ravi (eng): Revocation flow: propose immediate revoke + 30s undo (snackbar). For staged rotations, that's a separate epic. Let's not bloat this release. Add 'Schedule' as roadmap item.

elsa (a11y): Revocation dialog must be alertdialog, focus trapped, with aria-describedby pointing to the detailed warning text. Also ensure keyboard-only users can trigger undo via snackbar action.

leo (design): Empty state proposals: A) Simple CTA: 'Create your first key' + short explainer + 3 use-case chips (Server, Frontend, ML). B) Interactive demo key (ephemeral) for new orgs. Which do we prefer?

maya (product): Demo key for first-time orgs only. For existing orgs, show action-first empty state + quick cleanup tips. Add link to invite Key Manager role in empty state.

toni (devex): On list rows: add 'Last used' column and a small lock icon for restricted keys. 'View secret' button should only render for users with Key Manager role.
avi (eng): We'll add last_used to the API; role gating is straightforward via feature flags. Implementation note: for download blob, avoid inserting secret into DOM attributes.

elsa (a11y): Table headers must be keyboard focusable and announce sort state. Provide visible focus ring. High-contrast theme support required.

leo (design): Copy tweak for revoke confirmation: 'Revoking this key will cause apps using it to stop working immediately.' Stronger than 'key will stop working'.

maya (product): Action items: leo -> update mocks with inline secret + alternate drawer; elsa -> a11y checklist + sample aria snippets; toni -> download blob impl details + TTL masking doc; ravi -> API ticket for last_used and role gating. I'll add to sprint.
